links.outcome: Carbohydrate estimation error versus reference; large overestimations (>=+20 g) risking insulin overdosing
links.effect: Mean absolute error 13±10 g dietitians vs 20±18 ChatGPT, 28±26 Gemini, 23±21 Claude; large overestimations 3% experts vs 13% ChatGPT, 17% Claude, 38% Gemini.
links.quote: Large overestimations occurred in 3 % of expert estimates, versus 13 % (ChatGPT), 17 % (Claude), and 38 % (Gemini).

links.outcome: AI carbohydrate estimate error compared with expert dietitians on same meals
links.effect: Errors significantly higher for Gemini and Claude than dietitians, but not for ChatGPT (MAE 20±18 g vs 13±10 g).
links.quote: Errors were significantly higher for Gemini and Claude, but not for ChatGPT.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and safety risks (overestimation leading to insulin overdose) of general-purpose multimodal LLMs for carbohydrate counting in type 1 diabetes compared to expert dietitians, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
